result.reason: The redline appropriately narrows the restriction to the Deerskin-branded consumer website, limits it to the agreement term, and adds internal-development and acquisition carve-outs while preserving HDI’s relevant exclusivity. However, it does not cap the restriction at 12 months, so it fails the fallback if the agreement term exceeds 12 months. Drafting is generally professional, though the retained phrase “exclusive right to use of” is grammatically awkward and the affiliate carve-outs are partly unnecessary because the operative prohibition binds only the Company.
